# Alert

Figma: **5.4 Alert**. Sahifa ichidagi doimiy xabar: nima bo'ldi, nega va keyingi qadam.

```tsx
import { Alert } from '@bek/react';

<Alert tone="danger" title="Payment failed" primaryAction={{ label: 'Retry', onClick: retry }}
  secondaryAction={{ label: 'Later' }} onClose={dismiss}>
  Your card was declined. Try another card.
</Alert>
<Alert variant="solid" tone="warning" layout="stacked" title="Low balance">Add funds to continue.</Alert>
```

| Prop              | Qiymatlar                                                | Default  |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| `variant`         | `subtle` · `solid`                                       | `subtle` |
| `tone`            | `neutral` · `info` · `success` · `warning` · `danger`    | `info`   |
| `layout`          | `inline` (amallar yonida) · `stacked` (matn ostida)      | `inline` |
| `title`           | Title/S                                                  | —        |
| `children`        | izoh, Body/S                                             | —        |
| `primaryAction`   | `{ label, onClick }` — `action` (danger: `danger`) tugma | —        |
| `secondaryAction` | `{ label, onClick }` — `flat` tugma                      | —        |
| `onClose`         | berilsa — yopish tugmasi                                 | —        |
| `icon`            | holat ikonkasi o'rniga; `null` — ikonkasiz               | holat    |

- Tokenlar: Subtle — fon `status/{tone}/soft` (neutral `fill/tertiary`), Stroke ikonka 20 `text/{tone}`, sarlavha `text/primary`, izoh `text/secondary`. Solid — fon `status/{tone}/default` (neutral `fill/inverse`), matn `text/on-color` (warning `text/on-warning`), asosiy tugma `normal-contrast`. Padding 16, gap 12, radius `surface/md`.
- A11y: `warning`/`danger` — `role="alert"`, qolganlari — `role="status"`.

## Do / Don't

- ✅ Sabab va yechim: "Card declined — try another card". ❌ Faqat "Error".
- ✅ Bitta blokda bitta Alert. ❌ Bir nechta Alert'ni ketma-ket qalashtirish.

# Button

Figma: **3.1 Button**. Har qanday amal uchun bitta komponent: 22 Variant × 5 o'lcham, pill shakli.

```tsx
import { Button } from '@bek/react';

<Button variant="action">Save changes</Button>
<Button variant="outline-danger" size="l" startIcon={<TrashIcon />}>Delete</Button>
<Button loading>Saving</Button>
<Button variant="flat" pressed={isBold} onClick={toggleBold}>Bold</Button>
<Button variant="flat" iconOnly startIcon={<CloseIcon />}>Close</Button>   // "Close" — ekran o'quvchi uchun
```

| Prop        | Qiymatlar                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Default  |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- |
| `variant`   | `normal` · `action` · `danger` · `raised` · `outline` · `outline-{action·info·success·warning·danger·utility}` · `flat` · `flat-{…}` · `flat-secondary` · `normal-contrast` · `outline-contrast` · `flat-contrast` | `normal` |
| `size`      | `m` 28 · `l` 36 · `xl` 44 · `2xl` 52 · `3xl` 60 px                                                                                                                                                                 | `m`      |
| `startIcon` | `ReactNode` — o'lchami tugmaga qarab: 16 · 16 · 20 · 24 · 24 px                                                                                                                                                    | —        |
| `endIcon`   | `ReactNode`                                                                                                                                                                                                        | —        |
| `loading`   | spinner start icon o'rnida, `aria-busy`, bosish bloklanadi, ranglar saqlanadi                                                                                                                                      | `false`  |
| `pressed`   | toggle — `aria-pressed` (Figma: State=Selected)                                                                                                                                                                    | —        |
| `iconOnly`  | faqat ikonka; `children` ko'rinmas nom bo'lib qoladi                                                                                                                                                               | `false`  |

Qolgan `<button>` atributlari (`disabled`, `type`, `onClick`, `aria-*`) o'tadi; `type` default — `button`. Focus — `.bek-focus-ring` (faqat klaviatura).

## Qachon qaysi variant

- **Action** — hududdagi bitta asosiy amal (Save, Pay, Continue).
- **Normal, Outline** — asosiy amal yonidagi ikkinchi darajali (Cancel, Back, Export).
- **Flat** — toolbar, jadval qatori, "Show more".
- **Danger / Outline-danger / Flat-danger** — qaytarib bo'lmaydigan amal; Alert dialog (7.6) bilan tasdiqlang.
- info / success / warning / utility ohanglari — faqat ma'no tashisa. **Raised** — xarita yoki media ustida. **Contrast** — faqat to'q yoki rasm fon ustida.

## O'lcham va qurilma

- Mobile: default **xl** (44 px), asosiy amal **2xl** va to'liq kenglik; touch'da xl dan kichik emas.
- Tablet: touch'da xl, pointer toolbarida l.
- Web: formalarda **l**, zich UI'da (jadval, filtr) **m**; xl–3xl faqat marketing CTA.
- Guruhdagi oraliq: m/l — 8 px, xl–3xl — 12 px. Bir guruhda bitta o'lcham, ko'pi bilan 3 tugma.

## Matn

Fe'l bilan boshlang va natijani ayting: "Save changes", "Create project". 1–3 so'z, gap shaklida, nuqtasiz, bir qatorda. Sahifani almashtirsa — bu havola, tugma emas.

# Fieldset

Figma: **3.19 Fieldset** — bitta label, bitta control (yoki boshqaruvlar guruhi), bitta xabar. O'z label'i bo'lmagan istalgan control'ni o'raydi: Chip qatori, Checkbox/Radio guruhi, Segmented control, Slider, Date picker, yuklovchi. `layout`: `vertical` · `horizontal`; `status`: `helper` · `error` · `success`.

```tsx
<Fieldset label="Yetkazib berish" message="Kuryer 2 soat ichida yetib keladi">
  <SegmentedControl … />

  <Checkbox>Foydalanish shartlarini qabul qilaman</Checkbox>
</Fieldset>
```

Qoidalar (Figma doc + 1.12 Forms):

- Text field va Select'ni **o'ramang** — ularning label'i ichida (Filled).
- Bitta xabar: `helper` (format, chegara, keyin nima bo'ladi), `error` (validatsiyadan keyin, qanday tuzatishni aytadi), `success` (async tekshiruv o'tdi — promo-kod, username). Xabar almashtiriladi, ustma-ust qo'yilmaydi.

- `hint` — `information-circle` 16; matn `title` orqali va `<legend>` ichida ekran o'quvchiga beriladi.
- Fieldset'ning o'z holati yo'q: hover, focus, disabled ichidagi control'dan; Error — `status="error"` dan.
- `horizontal` — faqat Web formalarida (label chapda, `--bek-fieldset-label-width`, standart 10rem ≈ 160 px); Mobile va Tablet'da `vertical`.
- A11y: `<fieldset>` + yashirin `<legend>` (label, optional, hint); xabar `aria-describedby` bilan bog'lanadi, error'da `aria-invalid`.

# Loader · PullToRefresh

Figma: **5.7 Loading**.

## Loader

Trek + yoy ko'rinishidagi yuklanish indikatori (Figma "Spinner"). Tugma va input ichidagi kichik
sakkiz nurli belgi — [`Spinner`](../spinner/README.md).

```tsx
import { Loader } from '@bek/react';

<Loader />                          // 24 · default · cheksiz
<Loader size={40} label="Loading orders" />
<Loader tone="on-color" size={16} />
<Loader value={0.6} />              // aniq jarayon, aylanmaydi
```

| Prop    | Qiymatlar                                                 | Default   |
| ------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `size`  | `16` matn ichida · `24` ro'yxat, tugma · `40` butun ekran | `24`      |
| `tone`  | `default` · `on-color`                                    | `default` |
| `value` | `0–1` — aniq jarayon; berilmasa cheksiz aylanish          | —         |
| `label` | ekran o'quvchi matni; `null` — yashirin                   | `Loading` |

- Tokenlar: trek `fill/soft-hover`, yoy `accent/default`; On color — `fill/on-color-hover` + `static/white`. Halqa 11 % (ichki radius 0.78), yoy 135°, aylanish 800 ms linear.
- A11y: cheksiz — `role="status"`; `value` bilan — `role="progressbar"` va `aria-valuenow`.

## PullToRefresh

Ro'yxat ustidagi 64 px indikator. Ishora (gesture) mantiqi ilovada.

```tsx
<PullToRefresh state={state} progress={distance / 64} />
```

| Prop       | Qiymatlar                         | Default |
| ---------- | --------------------------------- | ------- |
| `state`    | `pull` · `release` · `refreshing` | `pull`  |
| `progress` | `pull` holatida 0–1 (yoy o'sadi)  | `0`     |
| `labels`   | holat matnlari                    | EN      |

- Pull: spinner 40 % shaffof, matn `text/tertiary`; Release (64 px chegarasi) va Refreshing: matn `text/secondary`, Caption/L. Release'da haptik signal bering.

## Do / Don't

- ✅ Butun ekran yuklanishida `size={40}`. ❌ Bitta blokda Loader va Skeleton birga.

# Mascot

Figma: **2.3 Mascot** — BEK maskoti, panda: `Mascot` (sprite-sheet kadri) va `MascotMessage` (maskot + sarlavha + tavsif + tugma). `pose`: `idle` + 8 qarash (`look-up`, `look-down-right` …) + 9 his (`happy`, `love`, `success`, `celebrate`, `wink`, `surprised`, `shy`, `sleepy`, `dizzy`); `size`: `xs` 32 · `s` 48 · `m` 64 · `l` 96 · `xl` 140 · `2xl` 200.

```tsx
<Mascot pose="sleepy" />                       // L 96, bezak (aria-hidden)
<Mascot pose="wink" size="m" label="BEK panda" />
<Mascot interactive size="xl" />                // kursorga qaraydi, bosganda reaksiya — landing, onboarding, 404

<MascotMessage pose="sleepy" title="Hali kurslar yo'q" description="Birinchi kursni qo'shing — tarix shu yerda ko'rinadi." action={{ label: "Kurs qo'shish", onClick: add }} />
<MascotMessage layout="inline" pose="love" size="m" title="Sevimlilarga qo'shildi" description="Saqlangan darslar Sevimlilar bo'limida." />
```

Varaqlar: panda `page-mascot` (MIT © Kamran Ahmed) dan, paket ichida (`@bek/react/assets/mascot/panda-{directions,reactions}.webp`) — standart holatda avtomatik yuklanadi; `directions` / `reactions` prop'lari bilan boshqa personaj berish mumkin. Bundler (Vite, webpack) varaqlarni o'zi oladi; bundler'siz Node SSR'da yoki Vite dev'da paket pre-bundle qilinsa (`optimizeDeps.exclude: ['@bek/react']`) — URL'larni prop bilan bering.

Qoidalar (Figma doc):

- Maskot **doim matn bilan**: maskot hisni, matn ma'noni tashiydi. Ekranda bitta maskot, hislar aralashtirilmaydi.
- His ekran ma'nosiga mos: bo'sh holat → `sleepy`, xato / 404 / aloqa uzildi → `dizzy`, muvaffaqiyat → `success`, onboarding → `wink`, yangilik → `surprised`, sevimlilar / rahmat → `love`.
- Statik holatda qarash pozalari ishlatilmaydi (faqat `idle` yoki his); qarashlar `interactive` rejim uchun.
- Rasm ranglari o'zgartirilmaydi, fon shaffof. Dark rejimda `fill/tertiary-hover` yoki undan yorug' yuzaga qo'ying — eng qorong'i yuzada qora quloqlar ko'rinmaydi.
- O'lchamlar: XS chat/inline · S toast, list item · M karta · L empty state · XL hero, onboarding · 2XL 404, to'liq ekran. Minimum XS 32.
- `label` berilmasa bezak (`aria-hidden`); yolg'iz yoki interaktiv bo'lsa `label="BEK panda"`.
- `MascotMessage`: `surface/card`, padding 32, gap 24, sarlavha ↔ tavsif 8; tugma `Button · action · m`. Figma doc jadvalida sarlavha Title/L, komponentda Headline/S — kod komponentga ergashadi.

# Navigation

Figma: **6.2 Navigation**. Web (≥ 1024), Tablet (600–1023) va Mobile (< 600) uchun ilova navigatsiyasi.

## Web: ModuleRail + MenuPanel + AppHeader

```tsx
import { AppHeader, AppShell, MenuPanel, ModuleRail, NavGroup, NavItem, NavSubList } from '@bek/react';

<AppShell
  header={
    <AppHeader
      start={<BekLogo size="s" />}
      end={
        <>
          <Button variant="flat" size="l">EN</Button>                                {/* Language */}
          <Button variant="flat" size="l" iconOnly startIcon={<MoonIcon />}>Theme</Button>
          <Button variant="flat" size="l" iconOnly startIcon={<BellIcon />}>Notifications</Button>
          <NavProfile avatar={<Avatar name="Alex Brown" size="s" />} name="Alex Brown" role="Administrator" />
          <Button variant="flat" size="l" iconOnly startIcon={<LogoutIcon />}>Log out</Button>
        </>
      }
    />
  }
  rail={
    <ModuleRail title="Apps" bottom={<NavItem mode="module" icon={<SettingsIcon />}>Settings</NavItem>}>
      <NavItem mode="module" icon={<HomeIcon />} href="/" selected>Home</NavItem>
    </ModuleRail>
  }
  menu={
    <MenuPanel collapsed={collapsed} top={<NavItem icon={<SearchIcon />}>Search</NavItem>}
      bottom={<NavItem icon={<SidebarIcon />} onClick={toggle}>Collapse</NavItem>}>
      <NavGroup title="Workspace" collapsed={collapsed}>
        <NavItem mode={collapsed ? 'collapsed' : 'expanded'} icon={<GridIcon />} href="/dash" selected>Dashboard</NavItem>
        <NavItem icon={<FolderIcon />} expanded={open} aria-controls="p-subs" onClick={…}>Projects</NavItem>
        <NavSubList id="p-subs" open={open}>
          <NavItem mode="sub" href="/p/alpha">Alpha</NavItem>
        </NavSubList>
      </NavGroup>
    </MenuPanel>
  }
>
  {page}
</AppShell>
```

| Komponent    | Asosiy prop'lar                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NavItem`    | `mode`: `expanded` 240×40 · `collapsed` 40×40 · `module` 40×40 · `sub` 32; `icon`, `badge`, `chevron`, `expanded`, `selected`, `disabled`, `href`                          |
| `NavGroup`   | `title` (UPPERCASE Caption/S `text/tertiary`), `collapsed`, `variant` `web`·`touch`, `divider`                                                                             |
| `NavSubList` | `open`, `variant` (`web` — 32, `touch` — 40 px chekinish)                                                                                                                  |
| `MenuPanel`  | `collapsed` (256 → 56 px), `top`, `bottom` (qotirilgan); `surface/card`, padding 8, gap 8                                                                                  |
| `ModuleRail` | `title`, `bottom`, `showLabels`; 64 px, `surface/raised`, padding 12, gap 4                                                                                                |
| `AppHeader`  | `start` (Menu button, Logo), `end` (Language, Theme, Notifications + Count, Profile/Avatar, Logout), `children` (Search); balandlik `layout/header/height`, `surface/card` |
| `NavProfile` | `avatar`, `name` (Label/M), `role` (Caption/M `text/tertiary`), `action` — Header `end` va NavDrawer `footer` uchun                                                        |
| `AppShell`   | `header`, `rail`, `menu`, `bottomNav`, `children` (`<main>`, padding `layout/page-margin`)                                                                                 |

- Header · Web (Figma): Logo · Language · Theme · Notifications (+ Count — tugma ustidagi Badge) · Profile (`NavProfile`: Avatar, Name, Role) · Logout — barchasi `start`/`end` slotlari orqali; Header · Tablet: Menu button · Logo · Search (`children`) · Notifications · Avatar.
- Nav item ranglari: Default `text/secondary` · Hover `fill/tertiary` + `text/primary` · Selected `accent/soft` + `text/accent` · Module Selected `accent/default` + `text/on-color` (hover `accent/hover`) · Disabled `text/disabled`. Radius 8, ikonka 20, Label/M (Sub — Body/S).
- `collapsed`/`module` da nom ekran o'quvchi uchun yashirin matn va hover/fokusda chip (`surface/raised`, `Elevation/3`, 8 px o'ngda).
- `href` berilsa — `<a>`, aks holda `<button>`; `selected` → `aria-current="page"`; `expanded` → `aria-expanded` + aylanadigan chevron.

## Tablet: NavRail + RailItem

```tsx
<NavRail bottom={<RailItem icon={<SettingsIcon />}>Settings</RailItem>}>
  <RailItem icon={<HomeIcon />} href="/" selected>
    Home
  </RailItem>
  <RailItem icon={<BoxIcon />} badge={3}>
    Orders

</NavRail>
```

- 72 px, `surface/raised`; element 56 kenglik, 56×32 pill indikator (ikonka 24), nom Label/S doim ko'rinadi. Selected — `accent/default` pill + `text/on-color` ikonka, nom `text/accent`; Pressed — `fill/tertiary`. 6 tagacha modul — qolgani drawer'da.

## Tablet / Mobile: NavDrawer + DrawerItem

```tsx
<NavDrawer
  open={open}
  onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
  header={<BekLogo size="s" />}
  footer={
    <>
      <NavProfile
        avatar={<Avatar name="Alex Brown" size="s" />}
        name="Alex Brown"
        role="Administrator"
      />
      <DrawerItem icon={<LogoutIcon />}>Log out</DrawerItem>
    </>
  }
>
  <NavGroup title="Menu" variant="touch">
    <DrawerItem icon={<HomeIcon />} href="/" selected>
      Home
    </DrawerItem>
    <DrawerItem icon={<BoxIcon />} badge={4}>
      Orders
    </DrawerItem>
  </NavGroup>
</NavDrawer>
```

- Kenglik `layout/drawer/width` (Tablet 360 · Mobile 304 — token qurilmaga ko'ra o'zgaradi, Figma `Device` prop'i kodda alohida emas), `surface/card`, `Elevation/4`; sarlavha `layout/header/height`; body scroll (padding 8 12, gap 16); footer `surface/raised` qotirilgan (profil — `NavProfile`, Settings, Log out).
- DrawerItem: `item` 48 px (ikonka 24, Label/L) · `sub` 44 px (Body/M); radius 12; Pressed `fill/tertiary`, Selected `accent/soft` + `text/accent`.
- Native `<dialog>` (`showModal`): fokus ichida, Esc va scrim (`bg/overlay`) bosilganda `onClose`; ochilish — chapdan siljish (`motion/overlay/slide`).

## Do / Don't

- ✅ Joriy sahifa doim `selected`. ❌ Bir vaqtda ikkita tanlangan element.

# Tabs

Figma: **6.1 Tabs** (Tab item + Tabs). Bir sahifadagi bo'limlar orasida almashish — WAI-ARIA tabs.

```tsx
import { Tab, TabList, TabPanel, Tabs } from '@bek/react';

<Tabs defaultValue="overview" type="underline" size="m">
  <TabList aria-label="Product" width="hug">
    <Tab value="overview">Overview</Tab>
    <Tab value="reviews" badge={12}>
      Reviews
    </Tab>
    <Tab value="faq" disabled>
      FAQ
    </Tab>
  </TabList>
  <TabPanel value="overview">…</TabPanel>
  <TabPanel value="reviews">…</TabPanel>
</Tabs>;
```

| Komponent  | Prop                                       | Qiymatlar                                        | Default     |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | ----------- |
| `Tabs`     | `value` · `defaultValue` · `onValueChange` | tanlangan tab                                    | —           |
| `Tabs`     | `type`                                     | `underline` · `pill` · `segmented`               | `underline` |
| `Tabs`     | `size`                                     | `s` 32 · `m` 40 · `l` 48 px                      | `m`         |
| `TabList`  | `width`                                    | `hug` · `fill`                                   | `hug`       |
| `Tab`      | `value` · `icon` · `badge` · `disabled`    | ikonka s 16 · m 20 · l 24; badge Subtle Accent S | —           |
| `TabPanel` | `value` · `keepMounted`                    | tanlanmagan panelni DOM'da saqlash               | `false`     |

- **Underline** — sahifa bo'limlari: qator gap 24, pastda `border/default`; Active — `text/accent` + 2 px `accent/default` indikator; Hover — `fill/soft` + `fill/control` indikator.

- **Segmented** — ixcham almashtirgich: konteyner `fill/soft-hover`, padding 2, radius 8; Active — `surface/raised` + `Elevation/1`.
- Matn Label/M (L — Label/L); Disabled — `text/disabled`. Padding s 12 · m/l 16; gap s/m 8 · l 12.
- Klaviatura: ← → (RTL'da teskari), Home, End — fokus bilan birga tanlanadi (roving tabindex). Panel `aria-labelledby` bilan bog'langan.

## Do / Don't

- ✅ 2–5 ta qisqa nom. ❌ Sahifalar orasida navigatsiya uchun Tabs (buning uchun Navigation).

# Toast

Figma: **5.1 Toast**. Amal natijasi haqida qisqa vaqtli xabar ("Saved", "Payment failed").

```tsx
import { Toast, ToastViewport } from '@bek/react';

<ToastViewport placement="bottom-end">
  <Toast
    tone="success"
    title="Changes saved"
    action={{ label: 'Undo', onClick: undo }}
    onClose={close}
  />
  <Toast variant="subtle" tone="danger" title="Payment failed" description="Try another card." />
</ToastViewport>;
```

| Prop          | Qiymatlar                                             | Default   |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `variant`     | `solid` · `subtle`                                    | `solid`   |
| `tone`        | `neutral` · `info` · `success` · `warning` · `danger` | `neutral` |
| `title`       | qisqa natija                                          | —         |
| `description` | ixtiyoriy izoh                                        | —         |
| `action`      | `{ label, onClick }` — bitta amal (Undo, Retry)       | —         |
| `onClose`     | berilsa — yopish tugmasi                              | —         |
| `icon`        | standart holat ikonkasi o'rniga; `null` — ikonkasiz   | holat     |

`ToastViewport` — `position: fixed` qatlam, `z/toast`; `placement`: `bottom` · `top` · `bottom-end` · `top-end` (keng ekranda burchakda).

- Tokenlar: Solid — fon `status/{tone}/default` (neutral `fill/inverse`), matn `text/on-color` (warning `text/on-warning`, neutral `text/inverse`). Subtle — fon `status/{tone}/soft` (neutral `fill/soft-hover`), sarlavha `text/{tone}`, izoh `text/secondary`, amal `text/accent`. Padding 16, gap 12, radius `surface/sm`, `Elevation/3`.
- A11y: `warning`/`danger` — `role="alert"`, qolganlari — `role="status"`. Yopish tugmasi `closeLabel` bilan nomlanadi.

- ✅ Bitta toast — bitta xabar va ko'pi bilan bitta amal. ❌ Toast ichida forma yoki bir nechta tugma.

Hover yoki fokusda chiqadigan qisqa izoh. Icon-only tugmalarda majburiy.

# Annotation

Figma: **4.18 Chart · Annotation** — ma'lumotdagi lahzani tushuntiradi, SVG `<g>` bo'lagi. `variant`: `marker` · `point` · `range`.

```tsx
<svg
  role="img"
  aria-label="Revenue 2026. Annotation: Price change on 1 May"
  width={480}
  height={200}
>
  {/* … chiziq … */}
  <ChartAnnotation x={x('2026-05-01')} text="Price change" note="Tariff +8% from 1 May" />
  <ChartAnnotation variant="point" x={320} y={48} text="Record" />
  <ChartAnnotation variant="range" x={60} x2={140} text="Holiday season" />
</svg>
```

- **Qachon:** ma'lumotdan tashqaridagi voqea o'zgarishni tushuntiradi (narx, kampaniya, uzilish) — `marker`; bitta qiymatga izoh (rekord, maqsadga yetildi) — `point`; davr soyasi (bayram mavsumi, test oynasi) — `range`.
- **Kodlash:** x (va `range` uchun x2) ← voqea sanasi, y ← qiymat (`point`), `text` ← teg, `note` ← to'liq izoh.

- **Interaksiya:** hover — `<title>` to'liq izohni ko'rsatadi; bosib yozuvni ochish yoki Mobile'da raqamli nuqtalar + chart ostidagi ro'yxat — ota komponent.
- **A11y:** chart xulosasida aytilsin: "Annotation: Price change on 1 May"; mustaqil ko'rinishda `label` shu matndan.
- **O'lchamlar:** teg `fill/inverse` pill (`radius/full`, padding `scale/2` × `scale/8`) + Label/S · `text/inverse`; chiziq `dataviz/target` · `chart/grid/stroke`, `marker` uzuq 4/4, tegdan `scale/4` pastda; `point` oyog'i `scale/16` + Chart/Data point Active; `range` soyasi `dataviz/grid`.     '1 Jul',
```tsx
    '2 Jul',

    '4 Jul',
    '5 Jul',
    '6 Jul',
    '7 Jul',
    '8 Jul',
    '9 Jul',
    '10 Jul',
    '11 Jul',
  ]}
  values={[48, 50, 47, 52, 51, 49, 78, 52, 50, 24, 55]}
  anomalies={[
    { index: 6, reason: 'Salary day + promo campaign' },
    { index: 9, reason: 'Payment gateway outage' },
  ]}
  expected={{
    lower: [40, 41, 41, 42, 42, 43, 43, 44, 44, 45, 45],
    upper: [56, 56, 57, 57, 58, 58, 59, 59, 60, 61, 61],
```

Figma: **4.18 Chart · Bar** — kategoriyalar bo'yicha qiymatlarni solishtirish; ustun doim 0 dan. `variant`: `vertical` · `grouped` · `stacked` · `horizontal`.

```tsx
<ChartContainer>
  {(width) => (
    <BarChart
      width={width}
      variant="grouped"
      series={[{ name: '2026' }, { name: '2025' }]}
      data={[
        { label: 'Jan', values: [42, 35] },
        { label: 'Feb', values: [51, 40] },

      label="Orders 2026 vs 2025: higher every month"
    />
  )}

```

- **Qachon:** 2–12 kategoriya. Grouped ≤ 3 seriya, Stacked ≤ 4 segment (qismlar yig'indisi), Horizontal — uzun nomlar va reyting (Mobile'da 6+ kategoriya bo'lsa ham).
- **Kodlash:** x = kategoriya, y = qiymat (0 dan), rang = seriya (`dataviz/categorical/0i`), radius (`chart/bar/radius`) faqat qiymat uchida.
- **Interaksiya:** hover — qolgan ustunlar 40%, `<title>` qiymatni aytadi; drill-down uchun ota komponent bosishni ushlaydi.

# Box plot

Figma: **4.18 Chart · Box plot** — har guruh uchun besh sonli xulosa (min, Q1, mediana, Q3, max) va chetlanishlar; guruhlar qator bo'lib chiziladi. `variant`: `box` · `violin` · `box-points` (Figma «Box + points»).

```tsx
<BoxPlot
  variant="box"
  sort
  data={[
    { group: 'Toshkent', values: [120, 160, 190, 210, 250, 340, 385] },
    { group: 'Samarqand', values: [80, 110, 135, 150, 180, 330], labels: ['#101', '#102'] },
    { group: 'Buxoro', values: [60, 95, 120, 140, 230] },
  ]}
  label="Order value by city: Toshkent has the highest median"
/>
```

- **Qachon:** 3–12 guruhda o'rtachani emas, tarqalishni solishtirish (shahar bo'yicha buyurtma summasi, jamoa bo'yicha javob vaqti); KPI uchun o'rtacha yoki mediana tanlashdan oldin og'ish va chetlanishlarni ko'rish. `violin` — shakl muhim bo'lsa (ikki cho'qqi); `box-points` — guruhda n < 50 bo'lsa, o'quvchi namunani ko'radi.
- **Kodlash:** qator ← guruh, x ← qiymat (umumiy shkala). Quti Q1–Q3 (`dataviz/categorical/01`, qatlam shaffofligi 0,28 + kontur, `chart/bar/radius`), mediana `chart/line/stroke`, mo'ylov va qopqoq grid qalinligida, chetlanish — `surface/card` ustida ichi bo'sh nuqta. Hamma guruh bitta rangda; rang faqat bitta guruhni ajratish uchun.
- **Qoidalar:** mo'ylov = 1,5 × IQR (Tukey) — `boxStats()`; qutidagi chiziq — mediana (o'rtacha emas; KPI o'rtacha bo'lsa Data point bilan alohida belgilang). Tartib ma'noli bo'lmasa `sort` — mediana bo'yicha. Bitta qiymat — faqat bitta chiziq va «n = 1», quti chizilmaydi; bo'sh guruh — «n = 0».
- **Interaksiya:** guruh ustida hover — qolganlari 0,4 gacha xiralashadi, `<title>` n, min, Q1, mediana, Q3, max ni aytadi; chetlanish ustida — xom qiymat va yozuv nomi (`labels[i]`). Yuklanish holati — Chart/Card Loading (Skeleton).
- **A11y:** `role="img"` + `label`; ko'rinmas jadval har guruh uchun n, min, Q1, mediana, Q3, max.
- **O'lchamlar:** chizma `scale/480` × `scale/200`, guruh nomlari ustuni `scale/80`. Guruh nomi Caption/M · `text/secondary`, o'q yozuvi Caption/S · `dataviz/label`, grid `dataviz/grid`, o'q `dataviz/axis`. Responsiv en — `ChartContainer`.
- **Yordamchilar:** `boxStats(values)`, `kernelDensity(values, xs, bandwidth)`, `silvermanBandwidth(values)` — Violin va Ridgeline bir xil hisobni ishlatadi.

```tsx
  periods={[
```

# Confusion matrix

Figma: **4.18 Chart · Confusion matrix** — klassifikator baholash: qatorlar — haqiqiy sinf, ustunlar — bashorat, diagonal — to'g'ri javoblar. `variant`: `counts` · `normalized`.

```tsx
<ConfusionMatrix
  labels={['Payments', 'Cards', 'Loans', 'Other']}
  matrix={[
    [412, 18, 9, 11],
    [22, 286, 6, 14],
    [7, 9, 198, 16],
    [21, 17, 12, 182],
  ]}
  variant="normalized"
  label="Ticket routing model: 86,9% accuracy; Other is confused with Payments most"
/>
```

- **Qachon:** klassifikatorni baholash (murojaatlarni yo'naltirish, firibgarlik, intent) — o'qitishdan keyin yoki production monitoringda; faqat umumiy aniqlik emas, qaysi sinflar adashtirilishini ko'rsatish. Sinflar nomutanosib bo'lsa — `normalized`. 2–10 sinf.
- **Kodlash:** katak rangi = qator ulushi, faqat `dataviz/sequential` 200 · 300 · 600 · 700 (`textCellLevel`, CMP-07); matn 200/300 da `text/primary`, 600/700 da `text/inverse` (`textOnCell` juftligi) — Light va Dark'da ≥ 4.5:1. `counts` — xom son (`412`), `normalized` — qator ulushi (`91,6%`); rang ikkalasida bir xil. `normalize` — `variant="normalized"` qisqa yozuvi.
- **Xulosa:** pastda `Accuracy 86,9% · 1 240 samples · columns = predicted` (Caption/M · `text/secondary`); `summary` bilan almashtiriladi yoki `false` bilan yashiriladi. `confusionStats(matrix)` — accuracy, precision, recall.
- **Interaksiya:** hover — katak konturi, `title`: haqiqiy → bashorat, son, qator %, precision / recall. Katakni bosish (xato namunalarga o'tish), qayta o'qitish xabari (`ChartInsight`) va yuklanish (`Skeleton`) — ota komponentda.
- **A11y:** haqiqiy `<table>`: `<caption>` (`label`, ko'rinmas), ustun sarlavhalari `scope="col"`, sinf nomlari `scope="row"` — ekran o'quvchi jadvalni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'qiydi; skroll maydoni klaviaturadan suriladi.
- **O'lchamlar:** `width` (`scale/480`) — tor ekranda gorizontal skroll; `height` (`scale/200`) — qator balandligi shundan (24–40 px). Katak oralig'i `scale/4`, radius `chart/bar/radius`; burchak va ustun sarlavhasi Caption/S · `dataviz/label`, qator nomi Caption/M · `text/secondary`, qiymat Caption/M.

```tsx
  {/* … chiziq … */}
  {i >= 0 && <ChartCrosshair x={points[i].x} y={points[i].y} xLabel="12 Oct" left={40} />}
```

# Diagram connector

Figma: **4.19 Diagram · Connector** — ikki diagramma tuguni orasidagi strelka. `variant`: `straight` · `dashed` · `elbow` · `labeled`.

```tsx
<svg width={480} height={120} aria-hidden="true">
  <DiagramConnector from={{ x: 0, y: 20 }} to={{ x: 120, y: 20 }} />
  <DiagramConnector variant="dashed" from={{ x: 0, y: 60 }} to={{ x: 120, y: 60 }} />
  <DiagramConnector variant="elbow" from={{ x: 160, y: 20 }} to={{ x: 280, y: 80 }} />
  <DiagramConnector variant="labeled" label="Yes" from={{ x: 320, y: 60 }} to={{ x: 460, y: 60 }} />
</svg>
```

`DiagramConnector` SVG `<g>` qaytaradi — diagramma `<svg>` (yoki `ChartSvg`) ichida chiziladi. `from` / `to` — SVG koordinatalari (tugun cheti); strelka uchi doim `to` nuqtasida.

- **Prop'lar:** `route` (`straight` | `elbow`) — chiziq yo'li variantdan alohida: `variant="dashed" route="elbow"` — uzuq ortogonal, `variant="labeled" route="elbow"` — yorliqli burilish. `direction` (`horizontal` | `vertical`) — Elbow burilish o'qi (oqim yo'nalishi). `active` — walkthrough'dagi joriy yo'l (`accent/default`).
- **Yordamchi:** `orthogonalPath(from, to, direction)` → SVG `d` (`M0,0H60V48H120`), `orthogonalPoints(...)` → burilish nuqtalari. Mind map, Swimlane, Org chart shu funksiyalar bilan ulanadi.

```tsx
<FeatureImportance
  contributions={[
    { feature: 'Income', value: 0.42 },
    { feature: 'Payment history', value: 0.31 },
    { feature: 'Debt ratio', value: -0.27 },
    { feature: 'Account age', value: 0.12 },
  ]}
  label="Income raised the score most (+0,42); debt ratio lowered it (−0,27)"
/>
<FeatureImportance variant="waterfall" base={0.35} contributions={contributions} label="From 0,35 base rate to 0,66 prediction" />
```

- **Format:** ishorali, haqiqiy minus: `+0,42`, `−0,27` (`formatValue`).

# Forecast chart

Figma: **4.18 Chart · Forecast** — kuzatilgan seriya (to'liq chiziq) va model prognozi (uzuq, `dataviz/ai/accent`) Prediction zone ichida, 80% va 95% ishonch oraliqlari bilan. `variant`: `default` · `target` (maqsad chizig'i).

```tsx
<ChartContainer>
  {(width) => (
    <ForecastChart
      width={width}
      labels={['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov']}
      actual={[42, 48, 45, 55, 58, 54, 67]}
      forecast={[
        { value: 71, range: { 80: [66, 76], 95: [63, 80] } },
        { value: 74, range: { 80: [66, 82], 95: [62, 88] } },
        { value: 78, range: { 80: [67, 88], 95: [63, 95] } },
        { value: 82, range: { 80: [71, 93], 95: [64, 100] } },
      ]}
      target={85}
      label="Forecast for November 82, likely between 71 and 93 (80%)"
    />
  )}
</ChartContainer>
```

- **Qachon:** model keyingi davrda nimani kutayotganini ko'rsatish (daromad, talab, balans). `target` — prognozni maqsad bilan solishtirish. Oraliqsiz prognoz — hech qachon.
- **Kodlash:** x = vaqt, y = qiymat, uzuq chiziq = prognoz (doim AI rangi, seriya rangi emas), band = har daraja uchun `[lo, hi]` (`dataviz/uncertainty/50 · 80 · 95`, `bands` bilan tanlanadi). Prognoz aynan oxirgi haqiqiy nuqtadan boshlanadi; "Today" belgisi (fill/inverse tag) ma'lumotni prognozdan ajratadi; Prediction zone — `dataviz/grid` fon, sparkles + "Forecast" yorlig'i pastki o'ngda.
- **Interaksiya:** prognoz nuqtalari ustida `<title>` — qiymat va oraliq ("Nov: 82 (80%: 71–93 · 95%: 64–100)"). `recalculating` — oraliqlar va chiziq 40%, legend yonida Spinner.
- **A11y:** `role="img"` + `label` xulosa (prognoz, oraliq, ufq), ko'rinmas `<table>`: Date · Actual · Forecast · oraliqlar. Sarlavhada ufqni ayting ("next 4 months").
- **O'lchamlar:** plot `chart/height/md` (200 / 240 / 320) → `height`, chiziq `chart/line/stroke` 2 px, prognoz uzuq 6/4. Responsiv en — `ChartContainer`.
- **Halollik:** oraliqlarni "soddalashtirish" uchun yashirmang — oraliqsiz prognoz va'daga o'xshaydi.

```tsx

<GaugeChart
  variant="zones"
  value={620}
  min={300}
  max={850}
  zones={[

    { to: 685, label: 'Fair' },
```

```tsx

  variant="positive"
  bands={3}
  data={[
    { series: 'Toshkent', date: '00:00', value: 42 },
    { series: 'Toshkent', date: '06:00', value: 118 },
    { series: 'Buxoro', date: '00:00', value: null },

  label="Load per region: Toshkent peaks at 06:00, Farg'ona at 15:00"
/>
```

- **Kodlash:** qator ← seriya, x ← vaqt, qiymat ← band (har band bir xil balandlik, ustma-ust buklanadi; to'qroq = kattaroq). `positive`: `dataviz/sequential/300 · 500 · 700`; `diverging`: asosdan yuqori `dataviz/diverging/pos-2 · 3 · 4`, past `neg-2 · 3 · 4`. Bo'sh qator — `dataviz/track`.

Mobil'da qator ≥ 24 px — ingichka qatordan ko'ra kamroq qator. Naqsh muhim bo'lsa qatorlarni cho'qqi vaqti yoki jami bo'yicha saralang (`series`), alifbo bo'yicha emas.

# Live chart

Figma: **4.18 Chart · Live** — real vaqt oqimi: oyna chapga siljiydi, bosh nuqta pulsatsiyalanadi, LIVE badge yangilikni ko'rsatadi. `variant`: `default`; `status`: `live` · `paused` · `stale`.

```tsx
<ChartContainer>
  {(width) => (
    <LiveChart
      width={width}
      stream={points} // [{ t: Date.now(), v: 42 }, …]
      window={5 * 60_000}
      domain={[0, 100]}
      updated="Updated every 5 s"
      label="Transactions per second, last 5 minutes"
    />
  )}
</ChartContainer>
```

- **Qachon:** har soniya / daqiqada yangilanadigan qiymatlar (kurs, yuklama, tranzaksiyalar), monitoring va operator panellari. Kunlik va sekinroq ma'lumot uchun emas — `LineChart`.
- **Kodlash:** x = vaqt (siljuvchi `window`), y = qiymat. Chiziq `dataviz/positive`, maydon `status/success/soft`, bosh nuqta `motion/duration/live-pulse` (1600 ms) bilan pulsatsiyalanadi.
- **Qoidalar:** vaqt oynasi qat'iy (oxirgi 5 daqiqa, oxirgi soat) — X o'qi siljiydi, Y o'qi barqaror: `domain` bering. Oxirgi ma'lumot qachon kelganini ko'rsating (`updated`).
- **Holatlar:** `live` — oqim; `paused` — foydalanuvchi pauza qildi, badge neytral "PAUSED"; `stale` — 3 intervaldan ortiq ma'lumot yo'q, badge ogohlantirish "DELAYED". Holatni ota komponent boshqaradi (`status`, `statusLabel`).
- **Interaksiya:** hover pulsni to'xtatadi (CSS); pause/play tugmasi va orqaga brush — ota komponentda (`ChartBrush`), oqimni to'xtatish ham.
- **Harakat:** `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` da puls o'chadi.
- **A11y:** `role="img"` + `label`, ko'rinmas jadval. Jonli hudud (`role="status"`) faqat `announce` o'zgarganda o'qiladi — uni har nuqtada emas, faqat chegara kesib o'tilganda yangilang.
- **O'lchamlar:** plot `chart/height/md` (200 / 240 / 320) → `height`; Y yozuvlari ustuni `scale/40`, badge padding `scale/2`·`scale/8`, gap `scale/6`. Matn: badge Label/S · `text/danger`, izoh Caption/M · `text/tertiary`, o'q Caption/S · `dataviz/label`.

# Marimekko chart

Figma: **4.18 Chart · Marimekko** — ikki yo'nalishli ulush: ustun eni = segmentning jamidagi ulushi, ustun balandligi kategoriyalarga bo'linadi — bozor hajmi va tarkibi bitta ko'rinishda. `variant`: `default` · `labeled`.

```tsx
<MarimekkoChart
  variant="labeled"
  data={[
    { column: 'Toshkent', category: 'Cards', value: 42 },
    { column: 'Toshkent', category: 'Loans', value: 28 },
    { column: 'Samarqand', category: 'Cards', value: 36 },
    { column: 'Samarqand', category: 'Loans', value: 30 },
  ]}
  label="Toshkent is half of the portfolio; cards lead in every region"
/>
```

- **Qachon:** hajmi juda farqli segmentlar bo'yicha tarkib (hudud × mahsulot); 100% stacked bar bitta ustun boshqasidan to'rt barobar katta ekanini yashirib qo'yadigan joyda. `labeled` — taqdimot va hisobotlar uchun.
- **Kodlash:** ustun eni = ustun jami / umumiy jami, katak balandligi = kategoriyaning ustun ichidagi ulushi, rang = kategoriya (`dataviz/categorical/01–05`). Ustunlar enidan kattasidan (chapda), kategoriyalar har ustunda bir xil tartibda, eng kattasi pastda (`categories` bilan o'zgartirish mumkin). 2–6 ustun × 2–5 kategoriya; qolganini "Other" ga yig'ing.
- **Yozuv:** matn kategorik rangga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'yilmaydi — `labeled` da % chip: `surface/card` + `text/primary` (Caption/S). Chip 40 × 22 dan kichik katakda chiqmaydi, qiymat `<title>` va jadvalda qoladi. Ustun ostida nom (Caption/S · `dataviz/label`) va `labeled` da ustun ulushi (`text/tertiary`).
- **Interaksiya:** hover — katak qoladi, qolganlari 40%; `<title>`: ustun, kategoriya, qiymat, ustundagi % va jamidagi %. Bitta ustun bo'lsa — `BarChart` (Stacked 100%) ishlating.
- **A11y:** `role="img"` + `label`, ko'rinmas jadval (ustun · kategoriya · qiymat · ustundagi ulush · jamidagi ulush); legend (`ChartLegend`, Square marker) — rang yolg'iz ma'no tashimaydi.
- **O'lchamlar:** `width` (`scale/480`), `height` (`scale/200`) — plot + ustun yozuvlari; katak oralig'i 2 px, radius `chart/bar/radius`, legend oralig'i `chart/legend/gap`, chart va legend orasi `chart/gap`. Shkala yozuvlari 0 / 50 / 100% (Caption/S).

# Ridgeline chart

Figma: **4.18 Chart · Ridgeline** — tartibli guruhlar bo'yicha bir oz ustma-ust tushgan zichlik egri chiziqlari; taqsimot vaqt bo'yicha qanday siljiganini ko'rsatadi. `variant`: `default` · `highlight`.

```tsx

  highlight="Jun"
  data={[
    { group: 'Jan', values: deliveryMinutes.jan },
    { group: 'Feb', values: deliveryMinutes.feb },
    { group: 'Jun', values: deliveryMinutes.jun },
  ]}
  domain={[0, 60]}
  label="Delivery time shifted from 35 to 20 minutes by June"
/>
```

- **Qachon:** vaqt bo'yicha siljish (oy bo'yicha yetkazish vaqti, reliz bo'yicha sessiya uzunligi); 4–12 tartibli guruh, har guruhga bitta zichlik. `highlight` — bitta guruh (shu oy) kulrang tarix fonida.

Maydon `dataviz/categorical/01` qatlam shaffofligi 0,28, chiziq `chart/line/stroke`; rang faqat ajratish uchun — `highlight` da qolganlari `dataviz/neutral`, maydon 0,16.

# Streamgraph

Figma: **4.18 Chart · Streamgraph** — markaz chizig'i atrofida oqadigan stacked maydonlar; kategoriyalar aralashmasi vaqt bo'yicha qanday o'sib-so'nishini ko'rsatadi. `variant`: `default` (silhouette) · `expanded` (100%).

```tsx
<Streamgraph
  variant="default"
  series={['Mobile app', 'Web', 'Telegram bot', 'Partners', 'Offline']}
  data={[
    { date: 'Jan', series: 'Mobile app', value: 420 },
    { date: 'Jan', series: 'Web', value: 260 },
    { date: 'Feb', series: 'Mobile app', value: 470 },
  ]}
  label="Traffic by channel: Telegram bot grew fastest since May"
/>
```

- **Qachon:** vaqt bo'yicha aralashma (kanal bo'yicha trafik, mahsulot liniyasi bo'yicha daromad) — umumiy shakl va yangi kategoriyaning o'sishi aniq qiymatdan muhimroq. `expanded` — faqat ulushlar muhim bo'lsa (100%).
- **Kodlash:** x ← vaqt (point), stacked y ← qiymat: `default` — d3 `stackOffsetSilhouette`, `expanded` — `stackOffsetExpand` (0 / 50 / 100% yozuvlari bilan); rang ← seriya (`dataviz/categorical/0i`, mahsulotdagi boshqa joylar bilan bir xil). Qatlamlar orasida `surface/card` ingichka chegara.
- **Qoidalar:** 3–7 seriya, uzun dumni «Other» ga yig'ing. Eng katta yoki barqaror seriya — pastda (`expanded`) yoki markazda (`default`); tartib `series` bilan. Aniq solishtirish uchun emas — faqat pastki qatlamning asosi tekis; aniq qiymat kerak bo'lsa Line (Multi) yoki Bar (Stacked). Bitta seriya — Line (Area) ishlating.
- **Interaksiya:** qatlam ustida hover — qolganlari 0,3, `<title>` seriya jami va ulushini aytadi. Legend toggle: `hiddenSeries` + `onToggleSeries` — yashirilgan seriya olib tashlanadi, oqimlar qayta oqadi. Sana bo'yicha crosshair + tooltip kerak bo'lsa — ota komponentda Crosshair / ChartTooltip bilan.
- **A11y:** `role="img"` + `label`; ko'rinmas jadval: har sana × seriya qiymati (`expanded` da ulush bilan) va jami. Legend matn bilan — rang yolg'iz ma'no tashimaydi.
- **O'lchamlar:** chizma `scale/480` × `scale/200`, legend ostida (`chart/gap`, `chart/legend/gap`). Vaqt o'qi Caption/S · `dataviz/label`, o'q chizig'i `dataviz/axis`; legend Caption/L · `text/secondary` (ChartLegend).

Figma: **4.19 Diagram · Swimlane** — bir necha ishtirokchi (odam, tizim, AI agent) o'rtasidagi jarayon. `direction`: `horizontal` · `vertical`.

```tsx
<Swimlane
  label="Kredit arizasi: 4 ishtirokchi, 7 qadam, 1 qaror"
  lanes={['Client', 'App', 'AI agent', 'Backoffice']}
  steps={[
    { id: 'apply', lane: 'Client', column: 0, shape: 'terminal', label: 'Apply for loan' },
    { id: 'validate', lane: 'App', column: 1, label: 'Validate form' },
    { id: 'score', lane: 'AI agent', column: 2, label: 'Score risk' },
    { id: 'approve', lane: 'Backoffice', column: 2, shape: 'decision', label: 'Approve?' },
    { id: 'offer', lane: 'App', column: 3, label: 'Show offer' },
    { id: 'decline', lane: 'Backoffice', column: 4, label: 'Explain decline' },
  ]}
  edges={[
    { from: 'apply', to: 'validate' },
    { from: 'validate', to: 'score' },
    { from: 'score', to: 'approve' },
    { from: 'approve', to: 'offer', label: 'Yes' },
    { from: 'approve', to: 'decline', label: 'No' },
  ]}
/>
<Swimlane direction="vertical" … />
```

- **Qachon:** qadamlar odamlar, tizimlar va AI agentlar o'rtasida o'tadigan jarayonlar (kredit tasdiqlash, onboarding, support) — kim nimaga javobgar va qayerda kutish/qaror bor. 2–6 yo'lak, ≤ 12 qadam.
- **Tarkib:** canvas `bg/sheet`, yo'lak nomi Label/M · `text/secondary`, ajratgich `border/hairline`; qadam — `DiagramNode` (Terminal · Process · Decision); bog'lanish — ortogonal `DiagramConnector`, qaror tarmog'i Yes / No pill bilan, ixtiyoriy yo'l — `dashed`.
- **Qoidalar:** `column` — oqimdagi o'rin; keyingi ustunga o'tish elbow bilan, bir ustundagi yo'laklar orasi — to'g'ri chiziq. Horizontal web, slayd va print uchun, Vertical tor ekran uchun. Canvas cho'zilmaydi — joy yetmasa gorizontal scroll.
- **A11y:** canvas `role="img"` + `label`; ekran o'quvchi uchun yo'laklar bo'yicha qadamlar va barcha bog'lanishlar ro'yxati (`bek-chart__sr`). Noma'lum yo'lak yoki qadam — xato bilan to'xtaydi.
- **O'lchamlar:** tugun 160 × 56 (Decision 80), qadamlar qadami 192 (`scale/160` + `DIAGRAM_NODE_GAP`), yo'lak 96, nom ustuni 112, chekka `scale/8`.

Figma: **4.18 Chart · Treemap** — ierarxik ulush maydon bilan; eng katta katak chap-yuqorida (squarified, `d3-hierarchy`). `variant`: `default`.

```tsx
<TreemapChart
  data={{
    name: 'Budget',
    children: [

        name: 'Transport',
        children: [
          { name: 'Taxi', value: 14 },
```
